title.zh: 金融控股公司（撤回指定）命令 2024
title.en: Financial Holding Companies (Withdrawal of Designation) Order 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Financial Holding Companies (Withdrawal of Designation) Order 2024 and comes into operation on 1 April 2024.
2. The designation of Singapore Life Holdings Pte. Ltd. (UEN 202020546N) as a designated financial holding company for the purposes of the Act is withdrawn.

heading.en: Amendment of Financial Holding Companies (Designated Financial Holding Companies) Order 2022

text.en: 3. In the Financial Holding Companies (Designated Financial Holding Companies) Order 2022 (G.N. No. S 519/2022), in the Schedule, delete item 3.
